d:
Thousands of people have taken to the streets across Greece in a nationwide strike, demanding higher wages, the restoration of holiday bonuses and better public services. The protests disrupted transport across the country, halting ferry services, affecting metro operations in Athens, and cancelling flights at several regional airports. The strike brought together public-sector employees, private-sector workers, teachers, doctors, students and transport workers. Samah Qundeel explains the reasons behind the latest strike.
